definitions.gloss: academic harassment; abuse of power in academic settings
definitions.explanation: Harassment or abuse of authority within academic institutions, typically by faculty, supervisors, or senior researchers against students, junior researchers, or staff. Abbreviated from アカデミックハラスメント. Includes unfair grading, withholding academic support as punishment, or demeaning treatment.

notes:
Abbreviation of アカデミック⟦ハラスメント→ハラスメント：11288_harasumento⟧ (academic harassment). Part of the broader Japanese ⟦ハラスメント→ハラスメント：11288_harasumento⟧ vocabulary for specific types of harassment.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦パワハラ→パワハラ：05904_pawahara⟧: power harassment (workplace abuse of authority)
- ⟦セクハラ→セクハラ：05905_sekuhara⟧: sexual harassment

- ⟦アルハラ→アルハラ：29041_aruhara⟧: alcohol harassment (pressuring others to drink)

NOTE: All these abbreviated forms follow the pattern of cutting down a long loanword and adding ハラ from ⟦ハラスメント→ハラスメント：11288_harasumento⟧.
